rationale: Independent reading: EO 9982 (13 FR 4375) only extends EO 9870 to and including June 30, 1949, effective July 1, 1948. Held EO 10011 (13 FR 6263) para. 3(b): 'Executive Order No. 9870 ... and Executive Order No. 9982 of July 29, 1948, are hereby revoked', proviso preserves existing rules and regulations only. Named whole revocation; its own term would also have run out June 30, 1949. I agree: NO.
